subject: the Nile
names: Agreement for the Full Utilization of the Nile Waters

facts.statement: Egypt and Sudan signed the Agreement for the Full Utilization of the Nile Waters on 8 November 1959.
facts.source: United Nations Treaty Series, vol. 453, No. 6519

facts.statement: The 1959 agreement allocates Egypt water measured at Aswan.
unitAliases: billion cubic metres of water a year
facts.source: United Nations Treaty Series, vol. 453, No. 6519

facts.statement: The 1959 agreement allocates Sudan water measured at Aswan.
unitAliases: billion cubic metres of water a year
facts.source: United Nations Treaty Series, vol. 453, No. 6519

facts.statement: Egypt, Ethiopia and Sudan signed the Declaration of Principles on the Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam in Khartoum on 23 March 2015.
Ethiopia began filling the dam’s reservoir in July 2020.
facts.source: Office of the Prime Minister of Ethiopia

facts.statement: Ethiopia inaugurated the Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam on 9 September 2025.
The installed capacity of the Grand Ethiopian Renaissance Dam.
